title: EDI and B2B Document Exchange Competitive Landscape

scope.description: Providers competing with Transus for EDI network, web EDI and e-invoicing subscriptions of retail suppliers, retailers and wholesalers in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: EDI service providers and networks with a sales presence in Transus' markets, and e-invoicing/Peppol providers that compete for the same mandate-driven demand. Excluded: ERP vendors' own EDI modules, generic iPaaS tools, and Transus' certified partners (Tickstar, Ecobit, NAS conception) and Katapull siblings.
scope.notes: Only figures found on official pages are recorded, with their reported scope; most private competitors publish no comparable figures. Transus itself states 100,000+ connected trading partners in 40+ countries, which is a network count, not a customer count.

players.name: SPS Commerce
players.description: Large retail EDI network provider (Fulfillment, analytics, e-invoicing). Acquired the Dutch EDI and e-invoicing provider TIE Kinetix (Breukelen) in 2023, giving it a direct presence in Transus' Benelux and German markets; tiekinetix.com now redirects to SPS Commerce Europe.

businessStats.sourceTitle: SPS Commerce Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results (Form 8-K exhibit)
TIE Kinetix is now part of SPS Commerce

businessStats.scope: TIE Kinetix customers in NL, FR, DE and US
businessStats.sourceTitle: TIE Kinetix is now part of SPS Commerce

players.name: TrueCommerce
players.description: Managed EDI and trading partner network for suppliers, with a large library of pre-built partner maps, ERP integrations and a UK and European presence; competes for supplier EDI and e-invoicing compliance. No official business figures recorded here.

players.name: ecosio
players.description: Cloud EDI as a managed service with Peppol connectivity and SAP integration, strong in German-speaking Europe (customers include Coop Switzerland); a direct alternative for Transus' German and Benelux customers. No official business figures recorded here.

players.name: EDICOM
players.description: EDI, e-invoicing and international electronic compliance provider active since 1995, acting as an integration hub across many countries' mandates; competes on multi-country e-invoicing for larger customers.

players.name: Banqup Group (formerly Unifiedpost)
players.description: Belgian e-invoicing, e-payments and e-reporting provider (Banqup platform, Peppol access point); competes with Transus for SME e-invoicing and mandate compliance rather than retail EDI.
